tools.name: bidsketch_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients (people or companies proposals are prepared for) with id, name, email and phone. GET /clients.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_get_client
tools.description: Get one client with full contact details, address, notes and secondary contact. GET /clients/{id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_list_client_proposals
tools.description: List the proposals of one client with status (Pending, Viewed, Accepted, Declined) and draft flag. GET /clients/{id}/proposals.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_create_client
tools.description: WRITE: create a client in Bidsketch. first_name, last_name and email are required (put a company name in `name`). Some Bidsketch plans cap the number of clients (HTTP 426 when reached). POST /clients.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_update_client
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing client; only the fields you pass are sent and overwrite the old values. PUT /clients/{id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_list_proposals
tools.description: List all proposals with name, status (Pending, Viewed, Accepted, Declined), draft flag and dates. GET /proposals.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_get_proposal_stats
tools.description: Proposal statistics for the account (the total number of proposals). GET /proposals/stats.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_get_proposal
tools.description: Get one proposal: status, client, currency, fee subtotals and total, tax/discount, settings and counts of its opening sections, fees and closing sections. GET /proposals/{id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_get_proposal_content
tools.description: Get the full content of a proposal in order: opening sections, fees and closing sections. GET /proposals/{id}/content.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_list_proposal_sections
tools.description: List the text sections of one proposal (opening and closing). GET /proposals/{id}/sections.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_get_proposal_section
tools.description: Get one section of a proposal with its HTML description. GET /proposals/{id}/sections/{section_id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_list_proposal_fees
tools.description: List the fee lines of one proposal with type, totals and the optional flag. GET /proposals/{id}/fees.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_get_proposal_fee
tools.description: Get one fee line of a proposal. GET /proposals/{id}/fees/{fee_id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_create_proposal
tools.description: WRITE: create a proposal for a client, optionally from a template (template_id from bidsketch_list_templates, which copies its sections and fees). The proposal is created as a draft; this tool does not send anything to the client. Some plans cap the number of proposals (HTTP 426). POST /proposals.js

tools.name: bidsketch_update_proposal
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of a proposal; only the fields you pass are sent and overwrite the old values. PUT /proposals/{id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_add_proposal_section
tools.description: WRITE: add a text section to a proposal, as an opening or closing section. POST /proposals/{id}/sections.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_update_proposal_section
tools.description: WRITE: change a section of a proposal; only the fields you pass are sent and overwrite the old values. PUT /proposals/{id}/sections/{section_id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_add_proposal_fee
tools.description: WRITE: add a fee line to a proposal; it changes the proposal's price. Fixed fees take amount as the total; hourly, monthly and yearly fees take amount per unit and a quantity. POST /proposals/{id}/fees.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_update_proposal_fee
tools.description: WRITE: change a fee line of a proposal (changes its price); only the fields you pass are sent. PUT /proposals/{id}/fees/{fee_id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_list_fees
tools.description: List the reusable fees saved on the account with category, type and total. GET /fees.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_get_fee
tools.description: Get one saved fee with amount, quantity, unit and description. GET /fees/{id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_create_fee
tools.description: WRITE: save a reusable fee on the account (it is not added to any proposal). POST /fees.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_update_fee
tools.description: WRITE: change a saved fee; only the fields you pass are sent. Proposals that already use it keep their own copy. PUT /fees/{id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_list_sections
tools.description: List the reusable content sections saved on the account with category and type (opening or closing). GET /sections.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_get_section
tools.description: Get one saved section with its HTML description. GET /sections/{id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_create_section
tools.description: WRITE: save a reusable content section on the account (it is not added to any proposal). POST /sections.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_update_section
tools.description: WRITE: change a saved section; only the fields you pass are sent. Proposals that already use it keep their own copy. PUT /sections/{id}.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_list_templates
tools.description: List the proposal templates saved on the account. Use a template id with bidsketch_create_proposal. GET /templates.json.

tools.name: bidsketch_get_template
tools.description: Get one template with the saved sections and fees it is made of. GET /templates/{id}.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bidsketch_list_clients, bidsketch_get_proposal_section, bidsketch_get_section · Private data: bidsketch_get_client · Public sink: bidsketch_list_clients, bidsketch_create_client, bidsketch_create_proposal, bidsketch_add_proposal_section, bidsketch_add_proposal_fee, bidsketch_create_fee, bidsketch_create_section · Destructive: bidsketch_update_client, bidsketch_update_proposal, bidsketch_update_proposal_section.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bidsketch_list_clients, bidsketch_get_proposal_section, bidsketch_get_section · Private data: bidsketch_get_client · Public sink: bidsketch_list_clients, bidsketch_create_client, bidsketch_create_proposal, bidsketch_add_proposal_section, bidsketch_add_proposal_fee, bidsketch_create_fee, bidsketch_create_section · Destructive: bidsketch_update_client, bidsketch_update_proposal, bidsketch_update_proposal_section

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
